After Replace Current, 4 wave tabs render. Toast confirms 'Imported 4 wave(s) with 6 resource(s).' NO Save click was performed on PRJ-0029 (DB state preserved).

action_items: Optional cleanup: The duplicate-code hazard flagged in iter62 still exists — /app/frontend/src/utils/calculations.js and estimatorCalcs.js coexist with divergent formulas. Recommend deleting calculations.js (effectively dead code; ProjectEstimator.js imports only from estimatorCalcs.js) to prevent future drift.

Optional UX: When Smart Import drops a sheet for any other reason (no AMS marker AND no allocations), surface a console.warn or list it under `result.warnings` so the user is aware which sheets were skipped.

Optional QA improvement: Add data-testid to resource grid rows (e.g. data-testid=resource-row-{idx}) — current test attempted [data-testid^=resource-row-] and found 0, so regression checks rely on Smart Import Preview counts. Per-wave resource count assertions in DOM would be more robust.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix #1 (excelImport.js): the new pre-scan at L207-211 correctly detects 'AMS SHARED SUPPORT' marker anywhere on the sheet (column A, rows headerRowNum+1 onwards). Gate at L213 is widened to `allocations.length > 0 || hasAmsSection`. Verified working live. Minor: pre-scan scans every row even for normal sheets — negligible cost for typical spreadsheets, no action needed.

Fix #2 (estimatorCalcs.js): `amsTotalCost = sum(hours_per_month × cost_rate) × contractMonths` is now added to `costToCompany` (L153) and `totalCost` (L152), exposed per-wave (L180) and aggregated as `totalAmsCost` in calculateOverallSummary (L199, L224, L249). OverallSummary.js L138 subtitle renders correctly. Correctly uses `cost_rate` for CTC vs `hourly_rate` for revenue (amsSharedMonthly/Annual). Implementation is clean.
Hydration warnings from visual-editor instrumentation (<span data-ve-dynamic> wrapping <tr>/<tbody>/<th>/<option>/<select>) continue — pre-existing, unrelated to this PR.
